'''Buitreraptor''' are small bipedal [[creature]]s found in [[Surroundings#Savage|savage]] [[Desert#Badlands|badlands]] and [[shrubland]]s, appearing in packs of 3-5. They are benign and will flee if approached. While [[Extinction#Extinct creatures|extinct]] in real life, their appearance is dependent on the settings chosen when [[World generation#Real world extinct creatures|creating a world]]. A young buitreraptor is called a ''buitreraptor hatchling''.

Buitreraptor can be captured in [[cage]] [[trap]]s and [[Animal trainer|trained]] into exotic [[pet]]s. They can be further trained into hunting beasts, but as they are less than half the size of a [[bobcat]], they are far better suited for [[egg production]]. A large [[egg]] size and high yield of 10-30 eggs per clutch put them on equal footing with [[alligator]]s in terms of volume, though they lack the boosted [[Item value|product value]], [[butcher]]ing returns, and defensive capabilities of their larger cousins.

Some dwarves [[Preferences|like]] Buitreraptors for their ''scything claws'' and ''feathers''.
